title: Project instance contract: badf init writes AGENTS.md + badf/{project.yaml,state.json,receipt} into the project, bounded and receipted
objective: Make 'a project governed by BADF' a real artefact: init runs DISCOVER -> CLASSIFY -> BASELINE -> GENERATE -> VALIDATE -> REGISTER and writes only inside <project>/badf/ plus <project>/AGENTS.md if absent; an init receipt is the first link of the evidence chain, digest-bound to BADF's own G00 evidence.
business_value: Without a project-side control plane, BADF governance exists only inside bstBizEra/badf; a project cannot be told what governs it, and nothing in it can be validated. Framework vs instance becomes an architectural distinction (BADF-DEC-0004).
in_scope: init: classification GREENFIELD|BROWNFIELD, baseline (SHA, clean tree, existing AGENTS.md digest), bounded write, receipt, state.json derived
refusals: dirty tree, existing badf/, the framework itself as target
existing AGENTS.md preserved and recorded as a conflict
BADF-side evidence init-receipt bound by digest
doctrine: framework vs instance; README: init contract
tests in scratch repos; PropTech only as a scratch clone
out_of_scope: authority instance with a framework floor (BADF-WP-0023)
agents/ councils/ sessions/ memory/ knowledge/ skills/ tools/ mcp/ policies/ releases/ operations/ learning/ -- each with its first record
any write to the real PropTech repository
#25 drift test for the documented intent fields
acceptance_criteria: greenfield: exactly AGENTS.md, badf/project.yaml, badf/state.json, badf/evidence/receipts/init-*.json appear; nothing else changes (digest outside the namespace equal)
brownfield with AGENTS.md: AGENTS.md byte-identical; receipt lists it as preserved with a conflict; badf/ still created
dirty working tree -> refused, nothing written
receipt.generated equals exactly the files that appeared, each with a digest
state.json is derived: baseline_commit == target HEAD, current_gate G00, authority UNRESOLVED
project.yaml round-trips through the gate's subset parser and through PyYAML where present
BADF-side evidence init-receipt.json digest == the instance receipt
no mutation of the real PropTech clone by any test
permissions: write: scratch git repositories under the test tmpdir only
evidence: post-merge simulation cited in the PR

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR; instances created meanwhile keep their files (they are the project's)

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design; reconciled by the next WP's branch.
